summary: Plan v13 Phase 4 (intFuel resize + init_le_fuel analogue + corpus re-verify) is BLOCKED: unimplementable as specified. The resize target 3^(4*(2c+1)*(WBound phi + 1)) must be materialized as a Nat numeral by every #eval corpus row — intuitionisticTableau strictly binds `let fuel := intFuel phi` (Expansion.lean:522-525) BEFORE intExpandBranches runs, so early exit bounds fuel CONSUMPTION but not fuel MATERIALIZATION. WBound is doubly-exponential ((s+1)^(2^s*s+1), s = (intSubfmls phi).toFinset.card): for corpus row 2 (a -> (b -> a)), s=4, WBound = 5^65 (~2.7e45), resized-fuel exponent ~5.4e46, representation ~1e37 GB. Empirical probe against the LANDED definitions (s, complexity, WBound digits, exponent digits): row 1 (2,1,5,6) feasible at 112,700 digits; row 2 (4,2,46,47), row 4 (5,3,126,127), row 6 (9,6,4610,4611), (a->b)v(b->a) class (5,3,126,127) all infeasible — 19 of 20 rows. Bounded materialization attempt of row 2's fuel (4 GB / 90 s) aborts with lean allocation failure. Root cause is structural, not a Phase 2/3 artifact: fuel-dominates-enlarged-measure (proof requirement, forces fuel >= 3^(~2|intUniverseExt|) with |intUniverseExt| = Theta(WBound)) and #eval-ability of intuitionisticTableau (corpus requirement) are jointly unsatisfiable; both are Phase 4 done-criteria. NO Lean edits landed — build/test remain green at the Phase 3 state; subtree bare-sorry count unchanged at 4 (all pre-existing). Full four-element defect record + three repair candidates in the plan's Phase 4 BLOCKER section; repair choice is planner-level (per-branch fuel restructuring / well-founded recursion on measure / proof-side-vs-eval-side procedure split) and gates Phases 6-7, which consume intExpMeasureExt_init_le_fuel.

blockers.detail: Joint unsatisfiability of two Phase 4 done-criteria: (a) intFuel must dominate intExpMeasure (intUniverseExt phi) [[(.neg, phi, 0)]] [[]], forcing fuel >= 3^(~2*|intUniverseExt phi|) with |intUniverseExt phi| = Theta(WBound phi), WBound doubly-exponential; (b) lake test must stay green, but every propositional corpus row #evals intuitionisticTableau, which strictly materializes the fuel numeral before any expansion step. For s >= 4 (19 of 20 rows) the numeral needs >= ~1e46 bits. The phase's Scope Hypothesis ('#eval cost is unaffected because runs exit at saturation/closure before consuming fuel') is refuted: early exit bounds consumption, not materialization.
